rules.name: Images
rules.reading: Images: 4 typestates over 4 checker nodes, lookahead 0; 5 rules (the start and one per typestate: in it each next typestate is possible and nothing else is). Faithfulness is decided as one bisimulation check: pass faithful a task or lean to compare a model with this protocol. Every message name labels one typestate, so the name alone is the state: no hidden state.

rules.name: start
rules.readingIndented: no message has been delivered yet and the conversation must go on

rules.name: typestate 0
rules.readingIndented:
on every path, whenever:
  no message has been delivered yet and the conversation must go on
the next step is one of these, each possible:
  - the conversation is just after GetImage and must go on

rules.name: typestate 1
rules.readingIndented:
on every path, whenever:
  the conversation is just after GetImage and must go on
the next step is one of these, each possible:
  - the conversation is just after Image and may stop
  - the conversation is just after NotFound and may stop

rules.name: typestate 2
rules.readingIndented:
on every path, whenever this holds, nothing else can happen:
  the conversation is just after Image and may stop

rules.name: typestate 3
rules.readingIndented:
on every path, whenever this holds, nothing else can happen:
  the conversation is just after NotFound and may stop
